Our Night Over Austin Skyline Helicopter Tour takes you 32 miles over the glowing cityscape of Downtown Austin and the shimmering waters of Lake Austin, offering an unforgettable aerial view of the city at night. Soar high above the illuminated skyline, where the Frost Bank Tower, The Independent (“Jenga Tower”), and the Texas State Capitol shine brightly against the night sky. Glide over UT Stadium, South Congress, and Lady Bird Lake, taking in the breathtaking views of Austin’s Experience Austin Like Never Before—After Dark

This 32-mile flight offers a bird’s-eye view of Austin’s downtown charm and vibrancy, giving you a once-in-a-lifetime experience over the heart of Texas.
